purpose: Cinco propuestas fotográficas del hero con secuencia automática, sin controles de carrusel, dirigidas con Impeccable.

variants.title: R · Luz desde la esquina superior
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE polished desktop website HERO design for IMSS JSDP Sonora, 1600x1000 landscape, edge-to-edge, crisp readable Spanish, no device/browser frame.
Reference 1 is the COMPLETE official site logo rasterized from JSDP-Sonora-11.svg. Place it as an intact image: IMSS emblem/letters, gray vertical divider, green JSDP, spaced dark-gray Sonora, three green/gold/gray underline segments. Never redraw, recolor, typeset a substitute or omit parts.
References 2–5 are respectively the actual project photos: brown hospital "Unidades médicas"; white office building "Unidades no médicas"; surgical team "Personas"; meeting "Coordinación". Use the indicated photograph faithfully as one full-bleed background across the ENTIRE hero below a white header. Most of the photograph must stay unobscured and naturally colored. Text overlays a localized soft white-to-transparent fade, with no hard panel or separate column.
Header: modest exact logo at left, nav "Inicio", "Conoce la JSDP", "Estructura", "Documentos", green "Iniciar sesión" button.
Hero reading block: exact logo again at moderate size; heading "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; body "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; green button "Conoce la JSDP". Green elegant serif heading, neutral sans-serif body; compact spacing, legible solid letters.
This is an AUTOMATIC background sequence with NO USER CAROUSEL CONTROLS: absolutely NO arrows, dots, thumbnails, pagination, progress bars, numbers, pause/play controls, tabs or category lists anywhere in the hero. Show exactly ONE small dark-forest rectangular label with white text naming only the CURRENT photo. That label is informational, not a button. No other captions, claims or slogans.
ACTIVE PHOTO: reference 2, brown hospital. Arrange the compact reading block in the UPPER LEFT with comfortably inset margins. The fade radiates softly from that upper-left corner into the photograph and disappears toward the center and bottom. Keep the facade, entrance, palm trees and ground visible across the lower and right majority of the hero. Reading block must not stretch into a full-height white column. Put the only label, "Unidades médicas", at LOWER RIGHT directly over a naturally colored portion of the photo. Clean quiet photographic composition, no white band at the bottom.
